events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Clay Holmes and three Cubs relievers combined on a three-hitter, and Seiya Suzuki hit a three-run homer Friday to send Chicago to a 3-0 win over the St. Louis Cardinals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clay Holmes shines in his 1st home start, Seiya Suzuki hits 3-run homer as Cubs beat Cardinals 3-0

headlines.description: — Chase Burns gave up four hits and struck out eight in seven innings, Eugenio Suárez hit an RBI double in the sixth, and the Cincinnati Reds beat the Miami Marlins 1-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chase Burns strikes out 8 in 7 innings, outduels Sandy Alcantara in Reds' 1-0 win over Marlins

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Brandon Lowe hit a three-run home run and rookie Rafael Flores Jr. homered for the third time in two days to lead the Pittsburgh Pirates to an 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lowe, Flores homer to power the Pirates over the slumping Red Sox, 8-4

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Miguel Vargas homered twice, Tristan Peters and Munetaka Murakami went deep once each, and the Chicago White Sox beat the Detroit Tigers 9-5 on Friday night
headlines.shortLinkText: Vargas hits 2 HRs, Peters and Murakami power five-run inning to lift White Sox over Tigers 9-5

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Dylan Beavers hit a two-run, pinch-hit single in the seventh to put Baltimore ahead to stay, Gunnar Henderson and Colton Cowser homered, and the Orioles beat Tampa Bay 6-5 on Friday night to snap the Rays' nine-game win streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beavers’ 2-run pinch-hit single sparks the Orioles’ 6-5 win over the Rays

events.name: San Diego Padres at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Luis Campusano and Xander Bogaerts each drove in three runs, Fernando Tatis Jr. homered for the fifth time in nine games and the San Diego Padres overcame an early three-run deficit to defeat the Cleveland Guardians 7-5 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres storm back from 3-run deficit to beat the Guardians 7-5, win 6th straight

events.name: Washington Nationals at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Francisco Lindor and Jared Young homered Friday night, powering the New York Mets to a 4-1 win over the Washington Nationals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Francisco Lindor and Jared Young homer to lead Mets past Nationals 4-1

headlines.description: — Brandon Pfaadt allowed only two hits in seven innings in another strong start, Tim Tawa homered in the ninth and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Atlanta Braves 2-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pfaadt throws 7 innings in the Diamondbacks' 2-0 victory over the Braves

events.name: New York Yankees at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Alejandro Kirk homered and hit a tiebreaking double, Shane Bieber pitched six innings to win for the fourth time in six starts and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the New York Yankees 3-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirk homers and drives in 2, Guerrero leaves injured as Blue Jays beat Yankees 3-1

headlines.description: — Christian Walker’s three-run home run with two outs in the 10th inning lifted the Houston Astros to a 10-7 win over the Seattle Mariners on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker’s 10th-inning 3-run blast lifts the Astros past the Mariners 10-7

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Jac Caglianone homered and drove in five runs on a three-hit night, Michael Massey also homered and had three hits and the Kansas City Royals beat the Los Angeles Angels 7-6 on Friday to snap a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Royals beat the Angels 7-6 to snap 4-game losing streak

headlines.description: — Jeff McNeil was 4 for 5 with three RBI including the go-ahead home run as the Athletics snapped a three-game slide with an 8-3 win over the Texas Rangers on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jeff McNeil goes 4 for 5 as the Athletics beat the Rangers 8-3

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Yoshinobu Yamamoto struck out nine in six innings and the Los Angeles Dodgers moved back within a game of the National League-leading Milwaukee Brewers with a 3-1 victory Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yoshinobu Yamamoto helps the Dodgers beat the NL-leading Brewers 3-1

events.name: Colorado Rockies at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Kyle Freeland pitched eight innings of one-run ball, Zac Veen hit his second home run of the year and the Colorado Rockies beat the slumping San Francisco Giants 5-2 on Friday night to take the opener of a three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeland's 8 strong innings, Veen's home run power Rockies past Giants 5-2
